guardrails: Do not weaken or bypass any verifier checks (no exclusions/disablements/threshold changes).
Do not modify application logic; this step must be formatting-only (gofmt).
Do not attempt to fix unrelated rubric failures in this step (COM-1, SEC-1, MAI-1, etc.).
Do not write outside hgm-infra/ except for the gofmt formatting changes required to satisfy CON-1.
Keep all new evidence and progress notes under hgm-infra/.
prompt.prompt_text:
You are executing roadmap milestone M1 (Make core lint/build loop reproducible), focusing only on rubric item CON-1 (gofmt/formatter clean).

Context (current verifier state):
- hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json shows CON-1=FAIL because several tracked .go files are not gofmt-clean.
- This step is intended to be purely mechanical formatting, with no behavior changes.

Your tasks (do in order):
1) Confirm current failure output
   - Read hgm-infra/evidence/CON-1-output.log to see the current list of files not gofmt-clean.
   - Do not start fixing other rubric failures in this step (e.g., COM-1 example module compile, SEC-1 gosec scan flags, MAI-1 file budgets).

2) Apply gofmt to ONLY the files listed by the verifier
   - Run gofmt -w on each file listed in hgm-infra/evidence/CON-1-output.log.
   - Keep the change set strictly formatting-only: no renames, no refactors, no logic changes, no comment rewrites unless gofmt does it.
   - If gofmt causes changes beyond those files, revert anything not in the list and re-run gofmt only on the listed files.

3) Re-run the deterministic verifier to refresh evidence
   - Run: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Confirm that CON-1 is now PASS in hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json, and that hgm-infra/evidence/CON-1-output.log now reports "gofmt clean" (or equivalent).
   - Do not attempt to “fix” any remaining FAIL/BLOCKED items in this step; just leave them as-is and let the verifier record them.

4) Record progress under hgm-infra/
   - Update hgm-infra/planning/lift-lint-green-roadmap.md in the "Progress snapshots" section with a new entry noting that CON-1 (gofmt) is now clean (include the date and reference the evidence path hgm-infra/evidence/CON-1-output.log).
   - Do not change rubric requirements or thresholds.

Acceptance criteria
- Running bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh results in CON-1=PASS.
- Only formatting-only diffs are introduced (gofmt output).
- Evidence artifacts under hgm-infra/evidence/ are refreshed and consistent with the verifier run.

Deliverables
- Updated gofmt’d files (formatting-only).
- Updated hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json + updated hgm-infra/evidence/CON-1-output.log.
- Updated hgm-infra/planning/lift-lint-green-roadmap.md progress snapshot entry.
prompt.step_description: Fix gofmt drift so the deterministic verifier’s CON-1 (formatter clean) gate passes.
